organisation.name: Cedar Lane Cooperative (invented for the test ledger)

fairness_line.wording: A goal is met only when it is true for every walk of life, every race, every age, every parish and every income.
fairness_line.why: Income is where an island average hides the most. Test reason.

goals.title: The Longest Healthy Lives on Earth
goals.wording: People here live more years in good health, in body and mind, than anywhere on Earth, and chronic disease is the exception at every age.

goals.title: A Home You Can Afford to Keep
goals.wording: Everyone who lives here has a secure home they can afford to keep, and owning one is within reach of every Bermudian who wants it.

goals.title: The 15-Minute Island
goals.wording: Anyone can get to what they need, and anything can get to them, within fifteen minutes, at any hour, without owning a vehicle.

goals.title: Private People, Open Institutions
goals.wording: Your identity and data are yours: you control how they are used and can see every time they are. Public bodies are open about the decisions they make and why.

goals.title: More Nature Than We Inherited
goals.wording: Reef, shoreline and native forest are healthier every decade, the ocean still feeds us, and we hand on more nature than we were given.

goals.title: Energy Independence
goals.wording: The island makes all the power and water it uses, and nobody's bill decides whether they can stay.
goals.why: Resilience describes a feeling. Independence is a state that can be measured. Test reason.

goals.title: Safe at Every Hour
goals.wording: Everyone is safe and feels safe, at home, on the road and on the water, at any hour.

goals.title: A Nation of Builders
goals.wording: Every child leaves school able to build a good life here, anyone can learn what they need next at any age, and trying an idea the world might value is cheap enough to be normal.

goals.title: A Good Life on an Ordinary Income
goals.wording: Work here pays for a good life, from the first job to a secure retirement.

goals.title: A Place Bermudians Choose
goals.wording: Bermudians choose Bermuda: to stay, to come home, and to stay connected wherever they live.

title: Cedar Lane Cooperative's Ten
preamble: A test entry. Builds on 002, replaces one goal and amends the fairness line, to rehearse replace, a chain of parents, a fairness-line change and a second candidate at a reading.
